![](thumbnail.png)

## Overview

This figure traces the growth of tertiary education enrollment in Brazil across more than a century, from 1907 to 2024, on a logarithmic scale. It overlays a single harmonized series against every competing historical estimate available, letting the reader see directly where sources agree and where they diverge, rather than taking the harmonization on faith.

## Methodology

The blue line splices six data sources using the `educabr2` package's deduplication hierarchy, in which the most disaggregated official source wins wherever sources overlap for the same year; grey points show every competing estimate from the underlying sources. Plotting both together makes the cross-source agreement, and the few divergent stretches, directly visible. The vertical axis is logarithmic: enrollment grew roughly a thousandfold across the century.

## Pipeline

Scripts for this analysis:

- Plotting: [`plot.R`](plot.R)
- Upstream pipeline: no script in this repository — the data comes embedded in the R package [`educabr2`](https://github.com/mancano-tales/educabr2).

## Reproducibility

**Tier: A (cross-repo)**

This pipeline depends on the public R package `educabr2` (`remotes::install_github("mancano-tales/educabr2")`), which already embeds the necessary data.
